text:
Tomas Hertl is 33, playing 15 and a half minutes a night, and still one of the most efficient forwards in the league. That's the Vegas bargain right now: 10 goals and 20 points in 26 games, and our wins-added count puts him 45th of 567 skaters.

The process backs it up. Vegas takes 61% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him on the ice, more than ten points better than without him, and his own chances (1.69 expected goals per 60) are up from 1.51 last season. If anything he's been a touch unlucky, finishing 1.4 goals below what his looks deserve.

His points pace sits at the very top of our talent range, so some cooling is fair, but this isn't a shooting heater. Eight of his points have come on the power play, where Evolving-Hockey had him earning most of his value last season too.

What to watch: his ice time dipped to 11:12 against Edmonton. If the minutes keep sliding, the production will follow, whatever the shot quality says.
headline: Hertl's minutes shrink, his chances don't
